subject.title: feat(tui): inline image rendering via pi-tui Image component

question: Should TUI inline rendering read absolute MEDIA paths from the host process, or should it render only trusted structured image blocks and media-store references?
rationale: The feature is useful, but the submitted shape crosses from tool/model text into host-local file reads and terminal graphics output, which needs maintainer product and security-boundary intent before merge.

options.title: Render Trusted Structured Media Only
options.body: Require the implementation to use current image blocks or structured generated-attachment/media-store references and avoid arbitrary absolute host path reads.

options.title: Allow Constrained Host MEDIA Reads
options.body: Keep host path reads only with an explicit trusted-root policy, focused tests, and live proof across local and Docker gateway setups.

options.title: Pause Under Canonical Tracker
options.body: Keep the open issue as the product tracker while this draft is rebased, narrowed, or replaced.

recommendation.title: Render Trusted Structured Media Only
recommendation.body: Require the implementation to use current image blocks or structured generated-attachment/media-store references and avoid arbitrary absolute host path reads.

likelyOwner.reason: The generated-image tool history and TUI product boundary make this the best available routing candidate from the likely-owner list.
